title: SiuuuRTP
description:
🌍 RTP – Advanced Random Teleport System
a lightweight RTP-Plugin for survival Servers,for players to randomly teleport in your world.
body:
🌍 RTP – Advanced Random Teleport System

A highly optimised, modern random teleport system for survival, SMP and RPG servers, designed for maximum performance, security and expandability.

⚡ KEY FEATURES

- 🚀 Ultra-fast randomised teleport algorithm

- 🛡️ 100% Safe-Teleport Engine (no lava/water/air spawn)

- 🌎 Multi-World Support (prepared)

- 🧠 Smart location filtering for secure positions

- 🔧 Modular & expandible for large server networks

- ❌ No GUI – Focus on performance & speed

🎮 COMMANDS

/Rtp → Start the Random Teleport

🔐 PERMISSIONS

Rtp.use → Authorised utilisation of /rtp

Rtp.bypass.cooldown → Removed Cooldown

Rtp.admin → Admin Access (Future Features)

🚀 TECHNOLOGY

- Async Teleport System (lag-free)

- Chunk preloading for stable positions

- Anti-Glitch & Safe-Spawn Protection

- Optimised for Paper/Spigot Performance

🔮 ROADMAP

- GUI Control Panel (optional)

- Biome-based RTP Filtering

- RTP Animation & Visual Effects

- Region Blacklist/Whitelist System

- Advanced Admin Tools

🏆 High-performance RTP system for modern Minecraft servers
